name: CSV to JSON
tagline: Paste rows from a spreadsheet and get clean JSON. It works the other way too.
seoTitle: CSV to JSON converter (and JSON to CSV)
description: Convert CSV to JSON or JSON to CSV for free in your browser. Detects commas and semicolons, handles quotes. Your data never leaves the page.

specs.Delimiters: Comma, semicolon, tab and pipe, detected automatically

faq.a: No. It's converted in this tab, and the page's security policy blocks it from sending data anywhere.

faq.q: Can I use an Excel file?
faq.a: Save it as CSV first (File, Save as, CSV). Reading .xlsx directly is on the list.
